subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this issue stay open as the canonical multi-agent orchestration umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with narrower canonical issues for completion delivery, fallback-lane ownership, orphaned locks, and detached-work cancellation?
rationale: The remaining failures span concrete bugs plus product/API choices about session ownership, completion payloads, timeout fallback behavior, and cancellation semantics, so automation should not choose the durable contract alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open while reviewing focused work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540, then close only after linked delivery, lock, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or intentionally split.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Promote narrower open issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89927, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92433, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975 to canonical owners, preserving the production evidence links before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Choose Metadata-Only Completion Direction
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975 the product contract for subagent completion isolation and map the delivery/lock fixes around that design.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while reviewing focused work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540, then close only after linked delivery, lock, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or intentionally split.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combination of recent code history and product-architecture boundary work across the affected paths.
